content.content: Skladba 'U Got 2 Know' od Cappella, vydaná v roku 2009, nás prenáša do éry dance hudby 90. rokov. content.title: U got 2 know

alternatives.text: "Cappella’s 'U Got 2 Know' is a masterful blend of dance and eurodance elements, evoking the vibrant spirit of the 1990s. This 2009 release showcases Bortolotti’s exceptional production skills, crafting an Italo-house anthem that resonates with its infectious beat and memorable vocal samples. A true gem in the genre, it continues to delight audiences with its timeless energy and sophistication."
